title: Native boot does not pair an assigned unpublished KFR pin into launcher kfr-root
body: The current-row Undertow boot failed at staging because launcher tools/kfr-root.sh fetched only the public wave branch and could not resolve the newly committed local KFR SHA. The documented recovery required exporting KFR_ROOT to the assigned exact KFR worktree before check-native-boot; suggested consolidation is to let the Undertow provider pairing manifest or launcher resolver carry the assigned local KFR root automatically.
